title: Anthropic web search/fetch tools result in infinite loop when using lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls

linked_prs.title: fix(ui): Don't resend messages for providerExecuted tools in lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls and lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithApprovalResponses
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Infinite client-server loop with provider-executed tool calls and `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls` (see #9943 ).

## Summary

Updated `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls` to return false when the only tool calls were providerExecuted tools.

## Manual Verification

I ran the same function on my application that uses the AI SDK.
